lines.zh: 钓鱼是我特别喜爱的一项运动。

lines.en: I often fish for hours without catching anything. But this does not worry me.
lines.zh: 我经常一钓数小时却一无所获，但我从不为此烦恼。

lines.en: Some fishermen are unlucky. Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish. I am even less lucky.
lines.zh: 有些垂钓者就是不走运，他们往往鱼钓不到，却钓上来些旧靴子和垃圾。

lines.en: I never catch anything -- not even old boots.
lines.zh: 我的运气甚至还不及他们。

lines.en: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
lines.zh: 我什么东西也未钓到过--就连旧靴子也没有。
我总是在河上呆上整整一上午，然后空着袋子回家。
”我的朋友们说，“这是浪费时间。

lines.en: But they don't realize one important thing. I'm not really interested in fishing. I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
lines.zh: ”然而他们没有认识到重要的一点，我并不是真的对钓鱼有兴趣，我感兴趣的只是独坐孤舟，无所事事！

question.en: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?

words.zh: On seeing the plane coming towards me, I dashed for cover.

”我的朋友们说，“这是浪费时间。
